## What's new

- Add manual accounts, including KiwiSaver, investments and debts, and see net worth by currency on Overview.
- Set savings goals against dedicated NZD savings accounts.
- Adjust forecast assumptions, move individual estimated dates and add recurring income or bills.
- Choose a date range for desktop spending charts.
- See recent activity for a selected bank beneath its accounts.
- Use ⌘1–9 to open banks; section shortcuts are now ⌘⌥1–6.
- Align the startup switch and fix a focus handoff that could dismiss the menu-bar dropdown.

Manual balances and forecast entries are stored encrypted on your Mac. Forecasts are estimates and do not make or change payments. Currencies are not converted.
